instructions: Test files follow the convention of the file they are in. One-line summary docstrings are acceptable when the neighboring tests use them. Review tests for what they prove: a test must fail when the behavior it covers breaks. Tests marked `@pytest.mark.live` (under tests/live/ and a few files in tests/integration/) call the real Mixpanel API on purpose; the default pytest options deselect them.

rules.rule: Tests not marked live must not read or write the real ~/.mp directory, the real Cowork bridge file, or real MP_* environment variables. tests/conftest.py provides the isolation: the autouse `_clean_mp_env` fixture scrubs every variable in `_MP_ENV_VARS`, and the session-scoped `_no_test_writes_to_real_home_mp` fixture fails the run in CI if anything under the real ~/.mp changed. Tests point config and storage at tmp_path (for example MP_CONFIG_PATH or the `config_path` and `temp_dir` fixtures). Flag a new MP_* variable or alias that production code reads but `_MP_ENV_VARS` does not scrub, and flag a test that reaches a real home-directory path.

Tests not marked live must not make real HTTP requests. Use `httpx.MockTransport`, for example through the `mock_client_factory` fixture in tests/conftest.py, or the mock pattern already used in the same test module.

The interrogate gate for tests/ is an aggregate (95%), so it does not catch a single undocumented definition. Flag a test function, test class, fixture, or helper that this PR adds with no docstring at all. A one-line summary that states what the test proves or what the fixture provides is enough; do not ask for Args, Returns, or Example sections.
